language.howToChooseYourGradeIntro: Our curriculum Grades K to 6 corresponds with ages:
language.howToChooseYourGradeContent:
It’s very important children start at the right level, have fun in learning and work at their own pace. Please help the children selecting the level that is not too easy, but also not too difficult for them. There are two ways to do this.

  • You can either check the learning goals yourself to determine the correct level for your child(ren).
  • Or you can let the child take several lessons to determine his or her level. For example, if your child has the age of 6, please let him or her take one lesson in grade K, one lesson in grade 1, and one lesson in grade 2 to determine at which level he or she is.

dialog.text: Hello, I am Tim.
Greetings, my name is Alexis and I am one of the actors at this ancient Greek theatre on the Mediterranean Sea.

Being on the edge of the Mediterranean Sea, you have a good view to see lots of sky. At night it's very dark, so you can see the parts of the solar system. The solar system contains a lot of stars and planets.
Because the theatre does not have a roof, we can use the real sky in our plays.
During the day we can use the sun as a natural light source. The sun is a star in the solar system that is so bright, we can see it during the day.
At night, we can not only see the Moon and stars, we can sometimes see a few planets as well.
We are getting ready for a play in the theater about some of the early astronomers and scientists. These people studied the solar system and helped us understand what we see in the sky.
We need to know more about the solar system, since it will be our scenery during the play. Do you want to join us? Let's go!
